rationale: The Court is most likely to issue a Roberts opinion denying the stay on narrow, status-quo and vehicle grounds, emphasizing that Humphrey’s Executor/Wiener remain controlling for multimember independent bodies and that the Government has not shown a clear likelihood of success given fact-bound “cause” disputes and mooting risks. Thomas and/or Alito are likely to write separately to stress Article II and remedial limits on mandatory injunctions against the President, while one or more in the majority may concur to flag remedial tailoring and reserve the broader constitutional question for merits review.
